scope: Current recipient privacy and blocking policy recheck before stored notification target authorization

canonical_plan_sync.follow_up: Synchronize the canonical plan without replacing unrelated concurrent task updates

policy.ownership_gate: exact notification, tenant and recipient lookup completes before any privacy or source call
policy.recipient_policy: the injected Notifications recipient policy is mandatory for every owned row
policy.policy_identity: tenant, recipient, actor, source event identity, notification type and target are reconstructed from the stored row
policy.suppression: any recipient policy suppression becomes inbox unavailable without invoking the source provider
policy.policy_failure: recipient policy failures preserve retryability through NotificationError::RecipientPolicyFailure
policy.source_order: source-owned authorize_target_open runs only after recipient policy allow
policy.allowed_output: only the fresh source-owned route is returned
policy.mutation_boundary: privacy and target authorization do not mutate seen read archive state or delivery attempts

not_delivered: seen read and archive state mutations
